composition_subtypes.role: Sort rectangles in descending order of width
Use max-heap to always pick the row with most remaining space

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort rectangles descending by width, then greedily pack each into the row with max remaining space using a max-heap, adding rows as needed.
payload.rationale: The solution first sorts items for the greedy strategy, then uses a priority queue to efficiently select the best-fit row, combining sorting and greedy mechanisms.
